kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتبعثر (form IIq)
# نَتَبَعْثَرُ (natabaʕṯaru) /na.ta.baʕ.θa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# نَتَبَعْثَرَ (natabaʕṯara) /na.ta.baʕ.θa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# نَتَبَعْثَرْ (natabaʕṯar) /na.ta.baʕ.θar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
